questions.question: Why did Nanami return to being a sorcerer?
questions.subject: Kento Nanami/Synopsis

answer.item: After taking care of a cursed spirit that was causing a baker problems, Nanami decides to return to being a sorcerer.

questions.question: Why did Nanami plan to finish the sewer fight quickly?
questions.subject: Kento Nanami/Synopsis

answer.item: Nanami begins to fight against Mahito and plans to finish the fight quickly since he doesn't like to work overtime.

questions.question: How was Mahito's Domain Expansion undone during the fight with Nanami?
questions.subject: Kento Nanami/Synopsis

answer.item: Yuji shows up and Sukuna wounds Mahito causing the Domain Expansion to be undone.

questions.question: Who did Nanami call the strongest Grade 1 sorcerer in his interview?
questions.subject: Kento Nanami/Synopsis

answer.item: At some point, Nanami was interviewed on who the strongest Grade 1 sorcerer was, with him claiming it was Atsuya Kusakabe.

questions.question: Why didn't Nanami let Nobara join him to help Gojo?
questions.subject: Kento Nanami/Synopsis

answer.item: Nanami says that this upcoming fight is for grade 1 Sorcerers and that she would only get in the way.

questions.question: What did Mahito do to Nanami at the end of the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Kento Nanami/Synopsis

answer.item: Mahito goes to kill Nanami by causing his upper body to gruesomely explode from the waist up with his Idle Transfiguration, leaving only Nanami’s hips and legs intact.

questions.question: What did Nanami say to Gojo in the afterlife?
questions.subject: Kento Nanami/Synopsis

answer.item: Nanami mocks Gojo for being satisfied with his death to a stronger opponent, calling him an old military general.
